content: Conversion evidence: speed-to-lead dominates. HBR (Oldroyd et al., 2011, audit of 2,241 firms) found responding within one hour made firms ~7x more likely to qualify a lead vs one hour later and ~60x vs 24h+; average first response was 42 hours and 23% never responded. Later vendor studies repeat 5-minute thresholds (directionally useful, vendor-biased). Gating: gated content produces higher-intent but far fewer leads, is invisible to AI search/citation, and low-value gates produce fake data; the defensible gates for a developer are high-value proprietary assets (full brochures, cost/payment schedules, availability) rather than top-of-funnel editorial. Form length is the largest lever: cutting one field can lift conversion substantially; progressive profiling plus enrichment beats long forms. Tour booking and brochure access are the two conversion events that map cleanly to a luxury developer's sales process.
